'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''  
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**The [[United States]] [[United Nations Security Council veto power|vetoes]] a [[United Nations Security Council]] draft resolution calling for an immediate humanitarian [[ceasefire]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. Thirteen other members voted in favor, while [[United Kingdom|Britain]] abstained. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/un-vote-delayed-demand-gaza-humanitarian-ceasefire-2023-12-08/ (Reuters)]
**The Gaza Antiquities Ministry reports that the [[Great Mosque of Gaza]], the oldest [[mosque]] in the [[Gaza Strip]], was destroyed by [[Israel]]i bombardment. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3244472/gazas-great-omari-mosque-ruins-after-israeli-bombing-hamas-says (''South China Morning Post'')]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russia]] launches 19 [[cruise missile]]s from [[Tupolev Tu-95|Tu-95]]s at [[List of cities in Ukraine|Ukrainian cities]], including the capital [[Kyiv]], killing at least one [[civilian]] in [[Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]] and injuring several others. At least 14 missiles are intercepted. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missiles-kill-one-wound-four-air-strike-ukraine-kyiv-2023-12-08/ (Reuters)]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine]]
***The [[Kiel Institute]] reports that pledges of aid to [[Ukraine]] have significantly decreased, reaching their lowest level since the beginning of the war. The amount of aid pledged to Ukraine has dropped by nearly 90% compared to the same period in 2022. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/8/russia-ukraine-war-list-of-key-events-day-653 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war]]
***[[Syria]] says that an Israeli [[airstrike]] killed four people in a vehicle in [[Madinat al-Baath]], [[Quneitra Governorate]]. Local media reports that the victims were affiliated with [[Iran]]-backed militias. Shortly after the airstrike, rocket sirens are triggered in Israel's [[Galilee]] region. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-777230 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Three people are killed and dozens are [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] during a fire at a hospital in [[Tivoli, Lazio|Tivoli]], [[Lazio]], [[Italy]]. [https://apnews.com/article/italy-hospital-fire-tivoli-st-john-evangelist-512b53b92f03b4c45035be503adcac20 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2023 Guayana Esequiba crisis]]
**Amid growing border tensions between [[Guyana]] and [[Venezuela]], the U.S. embassy in Guyana announces that the [[United States Southern Command]] will conduct joint flight operations with the [[Guyana Defence Force]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/us-expresses-support-guyanas-sovereignty-amid-border-tensions-with-venezuela-2023-12-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Armenia–Azerbaijan relations]]
**[[Armenia]] and [[Azerbaijan]] agree to exchange [[prisoners of war]] and work towards a [[peace treaty]] to formally end the [[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]] and normalize relations. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-67655940 (BBC News)]
*[[Accession of Ukraine to the European Union]]
**[[Prime Minister of Hungary]] [[Viktor Orbán]] reiterated [[Hungary]]'s opposition to opening [[European Union]] accession talks with Ukraine, citing concerns about Ukraine's readiness and the potential [[economic impact]] on the EU. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2023/dec/08/european-union-eu-viktor-orban-europe-live (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mexico|Mexican]] authorities raid and close 31 [[pharmacies]] in [[Ensenada, Baja California|Ensenada]], [[Baja California]]. The pharmacies were found to be selling counterfeit and [[fentanyl]]-laced pills. Working with marines and health inspection authorities, they seized 4,681 medication boxes suspected of being offered for sale without proper safety measures. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-fentanyl-ensenada-pharmacies-raids-88461569ff1c8a56281992be434bec28 (AP)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Chinese space program]]
**[[Zhuque-2]] successfully launches into orbit as the first rocket to achieve this using fuel composed of methane, the same as [[SpaceX]]'s [[Starship]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/9/chinese-methane-powered-rocket-launches-satellites-into-orbit (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Guatemalan general election]]
**The [[Attorney General of Guatemala|Guatemalan Attorney General's Office]] says that the results of the election are void and should be annulled, due to counting anomalies in the first round in June. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231208-guatemala-prosecutor-s-office-says-election-null-and-void (France 24)]
